units.title: Distributed System Fundamentals & Consistency
topics: Distributed System Models: synchronous vs asynchronous systems
CAP Theorem: Consistency, Availability, Partition Tolerance trade-offs
Distributed consensus protocols: Paxos, Raft, and Two-Phase Commit (2PC)
Quorum consensus systems (N, R, W parameters)

units.title: Cloud Virtualization and Resource Management
topics: Hardware virtualization vs containerization (Docker, cgroups, namespaces)
Hypervisors: Type 1 bare-metal vs Type 2 hosted
Serverless computing paradigms and cold start mitigation
Auto-scaling algorithms: reactive threshold vs predictive queue-based scaling

units.title: Distributed Storage & High-Throughput Pipelines
topics: Google File System (GFS) & Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS)
Distributed key-value stores: DynamoDB and Bigtable architecture
Partitioning strategies: Consistent hashing and virtual nodes
Stream processing and distributed message queues: Kafka and Google Cloud Pub/Sub

units.title: Fault Tolerance, Security, and Cloud Architecture
topics: Byzantine fault tolerance and fail-stop recovery
Disaster recovery planning: RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and RPO (Recovery Point Objective)
Cloud identity management, Zero Trust architecture, and IAM roles
Multi-cloud resilience and container orchestration with Kubernetes
